title: Sedative
summary: SEDATIVE, adjective [L. sedo, to calm.] In medicine, moderating muscular action or animal energy. SED'ATIVE, noun A midicine that moderates muscular action or animal energy. Se defendendo, in defendin

inlines.v: SEDATIVE, adjective [L. sedo, to calm.] In medicine, moderating muscular action or animal energy. SED'ATIVE, noun A midicine that moderates muscular action or animal energy. Se defendendo, in defending himself; the plea of a person charged with murder, who alledges that he committed the act in his own defense.
